Advance.description: With `actions`, the actions apply first at the current minute, and the answer carries their results.

name.description: The name of the season, for example "Saturday 15:00"

teams.description: Every team: first the teams that played all five worlds, ranked as in the final, then the others by `played`

marginCents.description: The sum of the five margins; null until the team has played all five worlds

onTimeShare.description: The on-time share over all orders of the five runs; null until the team has played all five worlds

played.description: The season's worlds at this level that the team has played to their end, deleted runs included: 0 to 5

rank.description: The team's place among ranked teams. Null until the team has played all five worlds, when a run missed the delivery minimum, and for a house team

ranked.description: True when the team has played all five worlds and each run passed the gate

runs.description: The ended runs, in the order of the worlds

deletedAt.description: The minute at which the team deleted the run; the world then played on to its end without your system

ranked.description: True when the run's score passed the gate

run.description: The world of the season, 1 to 5

CreateWorld.description: With `board: true`, the team's next ranking run at the level: the next world of the current ranking round, on a seed the server chooses. `seed` is then not allowed.

lastPickupAt.description: The last minute to collect the first undelivered car so that every undelivered leg arrives by its deadline, as `deadline_close` names it. It moves with snow, a change of plan and a delivered leg. When no pickup is on time, it is the first minute the car can be collected.

The last minute to collect the first undelivered car so that every undelivered leg arrives by its deadline, as `deadline_close` names it. It moves with snow, a change of plan and a delivered leg. When no pickup is on time, it is the first minute the car can be collected.

outcome.description: withdrawn: the gig was open and has left the board; post its other cars again. released: the gig was booked and held no other order's car: its driver is released under the release fees, and the gig has left the board. shortened: the gig was booked with another order's car: it keeps that car without this one, and its driver keeps the booked fee. continues: the driver had left: they skip this car's stops and are paid the full fee; the car is not delivered.

oneOf.description: No driver booked the gig before one of its stop windows ended, so none can: the gig has left the board, as after a withdrawal, and its cars can be posted again.
An order without a driver is 3 hours before lastPickupAt. It comes again when the order loses its driver later, and when its remaining work moves lastPickupAt to a later minute.

lastPickupAt.description: The last minute to collect the first undelivered car, when its site's stated hours show it open or inside a private seller's slot, so that every undelivered leg arrives by its deadline: by the road minutes, an electric car's charging stop and the delivery sites' stated hours. It is set when the order is won, and again when snow, a change of plan or a delivered leg changes the order's remaining work. When no pickup is on time, it is the first minute the car can be collected.

The last minute to collect the first undelivered car so that every undelivered leg arrives by its deadline, as `deadline_close` names it. It moves with snow, a change of plan and a delivered leg. When no pickup is on time, it is the first minute the car can be collected.

The last minute to collect the first undelivered car so that every undelivered leg arrives by its deadline, as `deadline_close` names it. It moves with snow, a change of plan and a delivered leg. When no pickup is on time, it is the first minute the car can be collected.

current.description: The ranking round that teams play now; null before the first season

previous.description: The season before the current one; null when there is none

Reveal.description: What your system could learn of the week, after a practice world has ended: every request with your quote and the dealer's answer, what was true of each car you won and when it moved, and the fee at each view of your gigs. Never the competitor's prices, a driver's costs, or the truth of a request you did not win.

deliveredAt.description: When the delivery counted: the driver's arrival, or the site's next opening when the driver left the car at a closed site; null when the car was not delivered.

deliveryHours.description: The delivery site's real hours; null at a private address.

manualGearbox.description: Only a driver with a manual licence could collect the car.

needsPlates.description: The car had no plates: a pickup without `withPlates` failed.

noteDeadline.description: A tighter deadline from the note; null when the note set none.

pickedUpAt.description: When a driver collected the car; null when no driver did.

pickupHours.description: The pickup site's real hours, which a note can say differ from the stated ones; null at a private address.

readyAt.description: When the car was really ready: a pickup before this minute failed as not ready.

releasedAt.description: When a car that waited for payment was released; null when it did not wait.

summerTyres.description: The car could not be driven in snow at either end.

option.description: The option the dealer took; null unless the desk won.

outcome.description: won: the dealer took one of the desk's options. lost: the dealer did not take the desk's quote. unquoted: the desk sent no quote.

quote.description: The desk's last price for each option it quoted; null when it sent no quote.

roads.description: Every pair of places in both directions, and each place to itself

boardRun.description: The ranking run's number in its season at its level, 1 to 5: the world of the season that it plays; null for other worlds

season.description: The ranking round of a ranking run; null for other worlds

info.description: The Spread API for your system. Times are world minutes from Monday 00:00; money is integer game-euro cents. On a practice world every request costs one practice token, whatever it carries. On a final world each action in a batch costs one action token and every read one read token. API.md gives the rates. Each answer to a team request carries RateLimit-Policy (the bucket), RateLimit-Limit (tokens a second), RateLimit-Remaining (whole tokens) and RateLimit-Reset (milliseconds to the next token, 0 when full) of the bucket that the request used.
